title: Malicious code in flintqueue (PyPI)
description: The flintqueue package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. These packages do not contain the payload themselves but serve as deceptive loaders for malicious code.
aiSummary: This threat involves the flintqueue package (version 0.1.0) on PyPI, which is identified as part of a campaign distributing loader packages designed to execute code fetched from remote URLs. While the package itself does not contain the malicious payload, it facilitates the execution of potentially harmful scripts. The campaign is characterized by multiple similar packages with coordinated intent to enable remote code execution through deceptive means.
aiImpact: The impact is the potential execution of remote malicious scripts on systems that install and run the flintqueue package version 0.1.0. This can lead to compromise depending on the payload delivered by the remote script. The package acts as a loader, enabling attackers to run arbitrary code remotely.
